# hatchet_organization_members (Data Source)

Fetches accepted members of the configured Hatchet organization. Pending invitations are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hatchet_organization_members" "current" {}

output "accepted_member_emails" {
  value = [for member in data.hatchet_organization_members.current.members : member.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Hatchet organization ID from the provider token.
- `members` (List of Object) Accepted members of the Hatchet organization.

### `members` Object

- `email` (String) Email address of the accepted organization member.
- `member_id` (String) Hatchet organization member ID.
- `role` (String) Hatchet organization role.
- `status` (String) Member status. Organization members returned by this data source are always ACCEPTED.
